note: Semantic outcomes of the major county decisions. The earlier campaign sets these. Until mapped, the runtime must pass 'unknown', which keeps every dungeon solvable and makes Distribute ineligible.

farm.preparedMeans: The player helped the farm hold its own seed, fences, and books so the place can bear a share without the office.

mill.preparedMeans: The player helped the mill keep its race, wheel, and settlement so the mill can bear a share.

crossing.preparedMeans: The player helped the ford or ferry keep a crossing that answers to its tenders, not only to the survey.

family.preparedMeans: Reunited is the only family value that can hold a share. Scattered and estranged cannot.
